chapter.verse: Kha Siangtho in a tel taka a genkholh inah, a tawpna hun ciangin,

amau lungsim uh kisuan’na-ah sik sa tawh ciamtehna a ngah khit uh ciangin, zuauthu a gen thei mite’ simtatna hangin mi kimkhat in upna thu zui nawn loin, a kheem thei khate ahi zongin, dawigilote’ thuhilhna ahi zongin a ngai ding uh a, kiteen’ loh nading ahi zongin, thuman thutak um-a a thei mite in hehpihna phat-a a neek ding uh Pasian’ bawlsa an pawl pawlte tan’ ding ahi zongin, a kham ding uh hi.
Pasian’ bawlsa khempeuh a pha hi a, hehpihna phatin a kisan’ leh, bangmah tan’ ding a om kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, Pasian’ thu tawh ahi zongin, thungetna tawh ahi zongin a kisiangthosaksa ahi hi.
Hih nate nang in ute naute kiangah na hilh leh, upna thu leh tu dongin nang na zuih thuhilhna a hoih tawh kivakin, Khazih Zeisu’ nasem hoihpa na hi ding hi.
Numei teekte in a gen theih uh ahi mawkna tangthute paaikhia in. Pasian biakna lamah nuamsa a, na om nadingin na kiseksak in.

Bang hang hiam cih leh, pumpi ading kiseksakna in phattuamna tawmkha a pia thei hi; Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna in tu laitak nuntakna leh tu nung ciangin a piang ding nuntakna tawh kipawl thu kiciamna ngah a, na khempeuhah phattuamna hong pia thei hi,
a cihna kam in thuman thutak hi a, a vekpi-in san’ ding a kilawm kam zong ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh Gumpa ahi, a um mite a man takpi a gum, a nungta Pasian, eite in muangin i um a, hahkatin semin, simmawhna zong i thuak hi.
Hih thute vaikhak in la, hilh in.
Khangno lai na hih hanginah kuamah kisimmawhsak kei in. Thugenna, gamtat ngaihsutna, midang itna, upna, siangthona sung pan a um mite ading limpha na suak in.
Ka hong pai matengin Lai Siangtho simin, mi hansuahna leh thuhilhnate hahkatin om in.
Genkholhna tawh, pawlpi upate’ khutngakna tawh nang hong kipia thupha letsong zang loin om kei in.
Na khan’tohna mi khempeuh mai-ah a kilat nadingin hih nate deihpha in la, hahkat in.
Nangmah ahi zongin, na thuhilhna ahi zongin, kikeem in la, na om in. Hih nate-ah na kip tawntung in. Tua bang na hih leh, nangmah ahi zongin, na thu a ngaite ahi zongin gupna na ngahsak ding hi.
